newspec-c: record-only → passed (record only (every judged cell passed, the rest is recorded only))
Our own addition (the 10-15 review keeps only R2 and R4); record only. Local Playwright spec newspec-c/an2-oat06-s21-double-tap.spec.ts on Post-Round, run twice with the same result. Hospital: a double tap on 'Complete task' writes one task_completed, but the second tap reopens the task (the chart save is optimistic, so the second tap lands on 'Reopen task'): the task ends open while a completion was counted; completing it again with one tap writes a second row (tasksCompleted +2 for one task). A double tap on Mark Encounter Complete writes one note_marked_complete (notesCompleted +1). Nursing Home: a double tap on the task's complete control writes two task_completed rows for one task (saves are not optimistic, both taps see the open task; tasksCompleted +2). A double tap on Mark Visit Complete writes one note_marked_complete (the server keeps one per chart per day). Suggestion, not a bug: count a completion once per task (debounce the control, or have the server ignore a completion of a task already done) so tasksCompleted is not inflated; the chart itself shows the physician the true state.

descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-06 Measuring How the Pilot Is Working (Usage Analytics) · S21 Impatient use and failures: double taps, leaving or reloading before an event lands, the handoff screen opened twice with one summary failing

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 Sending a handoff logs both the handoff generation and the send (UAT OAT-06 Test 4; TFA-94514 AC 3)
  • U5 Immediately after a handoff is sent, an in-app prompt appears asking 'Did having this make you more likely to send a handoff today?' (Yes / No / Not sure), and the answer is stored (UAT OAT-06 Test 4; TFA-94514 AC 3; TFA-94609 Spec 2; TFA-94609 AC 5)
  • U6 Completing an encounter fires both timestamps (Pre-Round summary opened, note marked complete), and they aggregate per physician per day (UAT OAT-06 Test 5; UAT 3.3; TFA-94514 AC 4)
  • U7 Per physician per day: notes generated, handoffs sent, and time from Pre-Round opened to note complete are aggregated and queryable in Convex (UAT OAT-06 Test 6; TFA-94514 AC 6)
  • U8 Completing a task and deleting a task are logged as separate events; task reminders are tracked live (completed vs deleted logged separately) (UAT OAT-06 Test 7; UAT OAT-06 Also confirm 1; UAT TC-24; TFA-94514 AC 2)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Fresh physician with Hospital patients 'QA Hosp OAT06 HoA', 'QA Hosp OAT06 HoB' (encounter boxes), note-ready 'QA Hosp OAT06 Tap' (one open task) and note-ready 'QA Hosp OAT06 Reload' (no tasks); Nursing Home resident 'QA Resident OAT06 Tap' (finished visit note, one open task); a colleague account; …

When R1 open the Hospital handoff screen, wait until Send is enabled, leave without sending; open it again, wait, send to the colleague, Skip the follow-up. R2 double-click the complete control on the open task (Hospital Post-Round on Tap, Nursing Home Post-Round on the resident). …

Then R1: exactly one handoff_sent (patientCount 2) and handoffsSent +1; HoB's sheet shows a chart-based summary with a message; the number of handoff_generated rows, their patientCount and whether the failed run counts are recorded (Q10). R2: task_completed = 1 per double-click, per context. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT OAT-06 Test 4/5/6/7 + TFA-94514 AC 2/3/4/6, and 3.5 'the physician taps Generate and can move to the next patient… the note appears when ready whether or not the chart is open'. Judged: R1 one send row with the sheet size and at least one generation row before it; R2-R4 one row per intended action (a double tap is one action); R5-R7 the event is present. …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S21 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-06.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: FAULT · Fault injection — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.
